## What this tool does

The agent calls this when you ask it to look at what a competitor is posting.

It reads their YouTube channel, tries their blog feed, and takes in any posts you pasted from LinkedIn, Instagram, X or TikTok.

Everything read is saved to the **competitor_posts** table. Nothing is posted and nobody is contacted.

## Your API key

The three blue boxes on this row need the **YouTube API Key** credential.

If they show a red warning, open each one, click the Credential dropdown, and pick it. Create it once under **Credentials → Query Auth** with the name `key`.

Full instructions: `docs/COMPETITOR_CONTENT.md`

No key? The tool still runs. It just skips YouTube.

## Why not LinkedIn and Instagram

Neither lets any app read another company's posts, and scraping them gets your account banned.

So those arrive by copy and paste, and this workflow only has to score them. That is why the skill asks you for numbers.

## How the ranking works

A post is compared with that same account's own typical post, not with yours.

YouTube is measured in views per day since publishing, so a video from 2023 does not beat a good one from last week just by being older.

`vsMedian` of 2.0 means twice their usual.
